The Person Behind Plastrix

Hi, I'm the one building your website

I've spent the last 2+ years designing and building websites for brands across fashion, food, wellness and D2C — 48+ projects shipped, 40+ clients who came back for more.

I work directly with every client, start to finish — no account managers in between. I design in Figma, build in Shopify or WordPress, and stay on for support after launch. If something breaks, you message me, not a ticket system.

Alongside web design, I also run digital marketing — so the site doesn't just look good, it brings people in.
